cards.title: The glass theme
cards.text: A look a site can wear: a theme is only values, and this is the package that holds them.

cards.title: An area to name
cards.text: A site writes .Glass() among its areas, and its areas list the glass theme.

cards.title: Its id and name
cards.text: glass in the page and its stylesheet, Glass on the switch, checked when it is made.

cards.title: Nothing else
cards.text: It registers nothing, brings no pages and names no component.
